Meta.siteTitle: IVF Master - सांगलीमध्ये प्रीमियम प्रजनन काळजी
Meta.siteDescription: IVF Master मध्ये वैयक्तिकृत IVF आणि प्रजनन उपचार. महाराष्ट्रातील सांगलीमध्ये तज्ञ डॉक्टरांकडून सहानुभूतीपूर्ण अनुभवा.

About.metaTitle: IVF Master बद्दल - काळजी, स्पष्टता आणि प्रजनन वैद्यक
About.metaDescription: IVF Master मधील डॉक्टर आणि टीमला भेटा आणि ऐकणे, शिक्षण व पुराव्यावर आधारित उपचार प्रत्येक प्रजनन प्रवासाला कशी दिशा देतात ते जाणून घ्या.

Team.metaTitle: Meet the people behind your care - IVF Master
Team.metaDescription: Meet Dr. Gorakh Mandrupkar, Dr. Saie Mandrupkar, and the people who make fertility care at IVF Master feel personal, clear, and safe.
Team.headline: You’ll know us by name — and we’ll know you.
Team.lead: From the first hello at reception to the doctor who guides your treatment, the same people walk with you the whole way. Here they are.
Team.doctorsHeading: The doctors who will know your story.
Team.doctorsLead: Warmth comes first. Decades of experience, careful medicine, and honest explanations are the quiet proof behind it.
Team.coupleNote: Married for over twenty years — and partners in every couple’s care.
Team.portraitPlaceholder: Portrait photo to be provided by the clinic.
Team.careTeamHeading: The people who’ll look after you.
Team.careTeamLead: These are the people who answer the phone, remember what you asked last time, and make the clinical parts of care feel human.
Team.facilityLead: A calm, private, modern clinic designed to make difficult conversations and careful treatment feel a little easier.
Team.facilitySwipeHint: Swipe to see more of the clinic.
Team.closingHeadline: Come meet us — the first visit is just a conversation.
Team.closingNote: No pressure — just the start of knowing each other.

gorakh.name: Dr. Gorakh Mandrupkar
gorakh.title: Fertility specialist and obstetrician
gorakh.essence: The doctor who explains until it finally makes sense.
gorakh.intro: Dr. Gorakh believes that understanding your treatment is part of feeling safe in it. He takes time to explain the science plainly, answer every question, and build a plan around the couple in front of him.
credentials: Developed the HDP Gestosis Score, adopted by India’s National Health Mission
Former director of a FOGSI IVF training centre
gorakh.imageAlt: Reserved portrait space for Dr. Gorakh Mandrupkar
gorakh.metaDescription: Meet Dr. Gorakh Mandrupkar, fertility specialist, Gold Medallist, and co-founder of IVF Master.

saie.name: Dr. Saie Mandrupkar
saie.title: High-risk obstetrician and reproductive medicine specialist
saie.essence: Gentle with people, fierce about their care.
saie.intro: Dr. Saie brings steadiness to the moments that feel most uncertain. Her work in high-risk obstetrics and reproductive medicine is grounded in careful attention, calm communication, and the conviction that every patient deserves to feel heard.
credentials: 20+ years in high-risk obstetrics and reproductive medicine
saie.imageAlt: Reserved portrait space for Dr. Saie Mandrupkar
saie.metaDescription: Meet Dr. Saie Mandrupkar, high-risk obstetrician and reproductive medicine specialist at IVF Master.

Hero.headline: गर्भधारण करण्याचा प्रयत्न क्वचितच सोपा असतो.
Hero.subheadline: का ते समजणे मात्र सोपे असू शकते.
Hero.body: IVF Master मध्ये, आम्ही प्रत्येक दाम्पत्याला प्रामाणिक उत्तरे, घाई न करता समुपदेशन आणि तुमच्या विशिष्ट परिस्थितीनुसार तयार केलेल्या योजनेसह मार्गदर्शन करतो.
Hero.ctaMicroTrust: तुमच्या परिस्थितीबद्दल एक शांत, घाई न करता संभाषण — पुढे जाण्याचा दबाव नाही.
